svg.title: Research publications
svg.desc: 1. Performance Analysis of Grover's Algorithm under Depolarizing Noise in NISQ Devices — Investigating quantum algorithm robustness under realistic noise conditions in near-term quantum hardware. 2. Federated Learning for Mental Health Applications: Adaptive and Privacy-Preserving Early Detection — Privacy-first federated architecture for early mental health condition detection, no sensitive data ever centralised. 3. CloudAIde: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Cloud Infrastructure Remediation Using Large Language Models — End-to-end LLM agent framework for detecting, diagnosing, and self-healing cloud infrastructure incidents autonomously.
